landing.headline: TRADE SMARTER.
landing.subheadline: Upload your chart → get your entry, Stop Loss and Take Profit in 10 seconds. AI-powered SMC analysis.
landing.step1Desc: Take a screenshot of your chart on Synthetic Indices or TradingView and upload it.
landing.step2Desc: Our AI detects SMC structures: Order Blocks, FVG, BOS, CHoCH and Liquidity zones.
landing.step3Desc: Precise entry, Stop Loss and 3 Take Profit levels calculated automatically.
landing.step4Desc: Connect your MT5 account (PRO/ELITE). The Dashboard tracks your profit, drawdown and trading days in real time.
landing.featuresHeadline: Everything you need to trade smart
landing.featureSMCDesc: Order Block, Fair Value Gap, BOS, CHoCH, Liquidity — all detected automatically.
landing.feature10sDesc: Full signal in under 10 seconds after uploading your chart.
landing.featureCalendarDesc: NFP, CPI, FOMC — real-time alerts with anticipatory signals.
landing.featureMarketsDesc: Boom, Crash, GainX, Volatility, EUR/USD, XAU/USD and more.
landing.featureMobileDesc: Optimized for mobile. Install the PWA app in 1 tap.

landing.testimonial1Text: I passed my FTMO challenge in 8 days with ProfityX signals. The Prop Firm dashboard saved me from 2 breaches.
landing.testimonial2Text: In 10 seconds I get my full analysis. Before I spent 45min per chart. Game changer for scalping.
landing.testimonial3Text: The Elite MT5 Robot has been running for 3 weeks on demo. Prop Firm Guard = total peace of mind.
landing.trackRecordDesc: Win rate, average R/R, every WIN and LOSS signal displayed. No filter.
landing.faq1Q: Which assets does it work with?
landing.faq1A: ProfityX works with all Synthetic Indices (Boom, Crash, Volatility, GainX, Step Index) and major Forex pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, XAU/USD, USD/JPY…). Select your asset before uploading your chart.
landing.faq2A: SMC is an institutional analysis method that follows "smart money" (big banks). ProfityX automatically detects Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, BOS and CHoCH on your chart.
landing.faq3Q: What is the Prop Firm challenge tracker?
landing.faq3A: Available in PRO and ELITE. Download the EA Tracker from your account, attach it to your MT5, and the ProfityX Dashboard tracks your profit, drawdown and trading days live. You get an alert before any rule breach.
landing.faq4Q: Does the MT5 Robot (ELITE) trade for me?
landing.faq4A: Yes. The Robot is an MT5 Expert Advisor based on a Trend-Follow strategy (EMA + Stochastic) with a built-in Prop Firm Guard: it automatically reduces lots when drawdown approaches limits and stops when the target is reached. Results not guaranteed — test on demo first.
landing.faq5Q: How do I pay from West Africa?
landing.faq5A: We accept Wave, Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Visa and Mastercard via GeniusPay. No international bank account needed.
landing.faq6A: Yes, no commitment. Cancel your subscription from your account page at any time, no fees.
